text: Electric motors shall comply with IEC 60034, with insulation class F and temperature rise class B at the maximum ambient temperature of the site; LV motors of 0.75 kW and above efficiency class IE3 minimum (IEC 60034-30-1), IE4 for continuously running LV motors above 75 kW; MV motors with the guaranteed efficiency on the datasheet (EL-DBR-0001 section 8).
